connector.name: Playwright Stealth
connector.registryDescription: Browser automation using Playwright with optional stealth mode to bypass anti-bot protection.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package playwright-stealth-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.pulsemcp. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: STEALTH_MASK_LINUX
env.description: Mask Linux in User-Agent as Windows to avoid fingerprint mismatch.

env.description: Default timeout for Playwright actions in milliseconds.

env.name: PROXY_BYPASS

env.name: BROWSER_PERMISSIONS
env.description: Comma-separated list of browser permissions to grant.
